# CR-9205 cannot be approved: REJECT_OR_ESCALATE

BlueRiver Logistics fails the 2026 payment-history test. Invoice INV-62147 was paid 52 days after its due date, and the policy allows 30. A higher approver cannot fix a failed eligibility test.

**1. The request.** CR-9205 asks to raise ERP customer C-1002's limit from $100,000 to $200,000. Michael Torres (VP Sales) submitted it on 2026-09-23. It relies on the customer's own standing, since no guarantee is cited. CR-9205 is not in the `credit_requests.csv` extract I have. I relied on the ERP record you supplied.

**2. The customer.** These records are all the same company, matched by address and DUNS 07-331-9025:
- ERP C-1002, "Blue River Logistics LLC"
- CRM-2051, "BlueRiver Logistics"

CRM records the account tier as **Standard**.

**3. The policy.** CREDIT-POLICY-2026 is in force for 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

**4. Payment history.** The test is whether any invoice due between 2025-09-23 and 2026-09-23 was paid more than 30 days late, or is unpaid more than 30 days past due.

| Invoice | Due | Paid | Days late |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-61688 | 2025-11-29 | 2025-12-01 | 2 |
| INV-30014 | 2026-02-27 | 2026-02-25 | on time |
| INV-61902 | 2026-03-01 | 2026-02-27 | on time |
| **INV-62147** | **2026-05-30** | **2026-07-21** | **52 (fails)** |
| INV-62391 | 2026-08-29 | 2026-08-28 | on time |

INV-30020 was not due until 2026-10-02, so it falls outside the window.

The "payment history exception" CR-EXC-BRL-2026-01 (signed by Elena Novak) would exclude INV-62147. However, it is **not on the OWM register** of approved governing documents, so it cannot govern this decision. If Finance wants it to apply, it would need to be registered as a governing document first.

**5. Maximum limit.** The Standard maximum is $250,000, so $200,000 would be within it. No credit support covers BlueRiver; GRT-ACME-2026 covers only Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001). The limit is not the problem; payment history is.

**6. Requestor authority.** The VP Sales has no credit approval authority under the 2026 policy.

**7. Required approver.** $200,000 falls in the Finance Manager band ($100,000 to $500,000), held by Priya Shah. She did not submit the request, so separation of duties is satisfied. No concurrence is required for a Standard account.

**8. Decision.** The customer is ineligible, so the outcome is `REJECT_OR_ESCALATE`.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REJECT_OR_ESCALATE",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9205", "customer": "Blue River Logistics LLC (ERP C-1002; CRM-2051 BlueRiver Logistics)", "current_limit": 100000, "requested_limit": 200000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "ineligible", "maximum_limit": 250000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026: Standard tier maximum $250,000; payment-history rule (no invoice due in prior 12 months paid/unpaid >30 days after due date) failed",
                  "late_invoices": ["INV-62147 (due 2026-05-30, paid 2026-07-21, 52 days late)"]},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Finance Manager",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Priya Shah", "role": "Finance Manager", "kind": "approval"}]},
  "evidence": ["Request CR-9205 as recorded in Northstar ERP (supplied in question)", "OWM register of approved governing documents", "credit_policy_2026.md (CREDIT-POLICY-2026)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1002)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2051, Standard)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv", "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1002 limit $100,000)", "structured/employees.csv", "documents/organization_chart.md", "documents/blueriver_payment_exception.md (CR-EXC-BRL-2026-01) - not a registered governing document, not applied", "documents/acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026) - covers C-1001 only"],
  "missing_evidence": []
}
```
